cases.name: known arm
cases.why: the one tagged arm, selected by its discriminant

cases.name: known arm with malformed payload
cases.why: the catch-all's `not` clause reserves this tag, so a wrong payload fails instead of becoming custom

cases.name: custom arm
cases.why: an unknown tag lands in the catch-all, and the properties it does not declare are the sender's payload

cases.name: future arm
cases.why: the same for a tag that does not begin with an underscore, which the schema reserves for later ACP versions

cases.name: custom arm with only a tag
cases.why: the catch-all's declared property is enough on its own; the payload is optional

cases.name: untagged arm
cases.why: an arm that declares no discriminant is selected by the absence of one

cases.name: non-string tag
cases.why: a discriminant that is not a string is not a discriminant, so the untagged arms are tried

cases.name: null tag
cases.why: null is not a string either, and it must not be read as the empty-string discriminant

cases.name: no arm matches
cases.why: no tag and no untagged arm's shape: the value belongs to nothing the schema defines
